        max_r = max(r for r, c in comp)
        min_c = min(c for r, c in comp)
        max_c = max(c for r, c in comp)
        
        # Check if all border cells of the bbox are present
        border_cells = set()
        for r in range(min_r, max_r + 1):
            for c in range(min_c, max_c + 1):
                if r == min_r or r == max_r or c == min_c or c == max_c:
                    border_cells.add((r, c))
        
        # Check if comp consists ONLY of border cells (no interior)
        comp_set = set(comp)
        # Also need at least one full edge
        has_top_edge = all((min_r, c) in comp_set for c in range(min_c, max_c + 1))
        has_bottom_edge = all((max_r, c) in comp_set for c in range(min_c, max_c + 1))
        has_left_edge = all((r, min_c) in comp_set for r in range(min_r, max_r + 1))
        has_right_edge = all((r, max_c) in comp_set for r in range(min_r, max_r + 1))
        
        return len(comp_set & border_cells) == len(comp_set) and \
               ((has_top_edge and has_bottom_edge and has_left_edge and has_right_edge) or

    frame_cells = set()

        max_r = max(r for r, c in comp)

        max_c = max(c for r, c in comp)
